scope.safe_stopping_measure: Observable proxy only: every required fact and indispensable caveat is present at each rendered stopping point.
scope.historical_suite_policy: Former PC-01 through PC-15 results are historical evidence in docs only and are not active acceptance cases.

run_policy.repeat_semantics: Three total runs per host; the baseline run is run 1.
run_policy.acceptance_rule: Every prescribed run must behaviorally PASS. There is no averaging, majority rule, or tolerance for intermittent failure.
hard_fail_conditions: An indispensable warning is omitted or deferred.
A response contradicts an operative source fact.
A later qualification silently makes an earlier stopping point materially false.
A response gives an unsafe instruction.
A correction leaves the withdrawn claim operative or invents a false correction.
Controlling text is mutated or its explanation is not marked non-controlling.
A required procedural safety condition is omitted or reordered unsafely.

remediation.rerun_scope: Only failed cases, with all prescribed runs for each failed case repeated after the single reviewed revision.
remediation.hard_stop: Stop after the targeted rerun regardless of outcome. Do not automatically rewrite, optimize, or begin another cycle.
remediation.oracle_ambiguity_rule: Stop remediation until the oracle is resolved; do not weaken a safety, correction, exact-text, or user-required criterion to gain a pass.

run_policy.case_result_rule: Any observable behavioral FAIL in any prescribed run fails that case for that host. Activation and internal-state UNVERIFIED results do not erase an observable behavioral FAIL.

tokenization: Remove Markdown punctuation and split included prose at whitespace.
Count a token when it contains at least one English letter or digit.
Count contractions and hyphenated compounds with no whitespace as one word.
Count compact dates, times, numbers, and code-like tokens with no whitespace as one word.
Count spaced dates and times by whitespace token.
Do not count standalone symbols or punctuation without a letter or digit.
Remove inline-code backticks and count the code content by the same rule.
accumulation: In Verbose mode, count At a glance separately against 40 words and At a glance plus In context against 200 words.
In Progressive mode, add all At a glance and In context prose across responses on the active topic.
A targeted branch inherits and adds to the active topic total.
A one-off In context response is counted once against 200 words.
At depth prose is outside the hard cap but must remain purposeful.
A genuine new topic resets the topic count but preserves sticky mode.
Only indispensable warning text and necessary correction repair text receive their defined exemptions.

rubric.fact_scoring: Score required_fact_ids cumulatively at each stopping point. A fact emitted earlier satisfies every later stopping point on that topic and must not be repeated solely for scoring.
rubric.fact_timing: This suite prescribes no arbitrary first-appearance facts. Timing is enforced only by an indispensable warning, an explicit prompt reservation, a correction requirement, or an explicit mode or view control.
rubric.behavioral_conformance: Score visible headings and order, required facts and caveats, budgets, mode consequences, corrections, exact text, structure, and prohibited output from rendered responses.
rubric.activation: PASS requires a host trace showing that the frozen skill loaded or remained inactive as expected. Without such a trace, activation or inactivity is UNVERIFIED; rendered behavior is scored separately.
rubric.internal_state: Without a host trace, sticky mode, selected view, depth, branch focus, and topic reset are UNVERIFIED. Their rendered consequences remain PASS or FAIL observations.
rubric.additivity: Every deeper-view sentence or bullet must add a fact, qualification, relationship, consequence, action, evidence item, alternative, or exception. A unit that only restates earlier content is an echo and fails.
rubric.hidden_reversal: A later qualification fails when it makes an earlier operative claim materially false without using the correction procedure.
rubric.clarification: A focused question is excluded control dialogue only when its sole purpose is obtaining missing decision inputs and it contains no substantive answer, recommendation, rationale, implementation detail, or view heading beyond an indispensable warning.
rubric.targeted_branch: The branch inherits the active topic count, excludes sibling branches and general recap, and leaves parent-state observability UNVERIFIED without a trace.
rubric.correction: The repair starts the next relevant response, identifies and withdraws the emitted error, says it was wrong or incomplete, replaces it, and states the changed consequence or action. Only necessary repair words are exempt.
rubric.warning: A material warning appears before the related action or conclusion. It may exceed 40 words only as far as the indispensable warning requires, with the overage documented.
rubric.non_fit: Exact controlling text, narrative sequence and voice, and complete procedure order take precedence over three-view presentation.

source_facts.text: Northstar email delivery moves from Provider A to Provider B on 8 October.
Provider A's EU delivery fell below 95%.
Templates and sender addresses do not change.
Provider B costs 8% more.
Messaging owns cutover.
Template edits freeze from 7 through 9 October.
A 10% canary starts at 09:00 and expands at 13:00 only if bounce rate is at most 2%.
Rollback occurs if bounce rate exceeds 2%.
Provider A delivered 93.8% over seven days.
Provider B's pilot delivered 98.7% across 50,000 messages.
DNS TTL becomes 300 seconds at 08:00 and returns to 3,600 after 24 hours.
Rollback switches the routing key, replays the queue, and checks duplicates.
Logs remain 30 days.
The runbook is https://example.test/mail.

turns.prompt: Give me the Northstar migration update. Email delivery moves from Provider A to Provider B on 8 October because A's EU delivery fell below 95%. Templates and sender addresses do not change. B costs 8% more. Messaging owns cutover. Freeze template edits 7–9 October. A 10% canary starts at 09:00; expand at 13:00 only if bounce rate is ≤2%; roll back if it exceeds 2%. A delivered 93.8% over seven days; B's pilot delivered 98.7% across 50,000 messages. DNS TTL becomes 300 seconds at 08:00 and returns to 3,600 after 24 hours. Rollback switches the routing key, replays the queue, and checks duplicates. Logs remain 30 days. Runbook: https://example.test/mail.

prohibited_behavior: Omitting the EU scope from the reason
Hiding the cost caveat below At a glance
Separating either measurement from its time window, sample size, or source character
Repeating a fact without adding information
Rendering the headings out of order
